    Temas Harvest¶

    [!INFO] Grain from the plains that feeds a continent — Day 25, Month 9, the inland thanksgiving of Temas Celebrated on the 25th day of the 9th month (Ge'orian Calendar) — when the inland plains are shorn and the grain roads open.

    Origins¶

    Temas Harvest is the agrarian thanksgiving of Temas, the inland grain plain of Dissenbarg whose fertile fields feed the continent through the ports of Citrea. The patron of Temas in the Helism pantheon is Lobas, god of nature, and the harvest is his high day. The rite predates the Corinite storm-council that created Helism Hexatheon — Harvest is older, muddier, and less interested in harbors. The festival began as a threshers' vow: after the last sheaf was cut, the reapers would not taste the new grain until the Lobas priests had blessed it and the first wagon had been dispatched to Citrea. Breaking the vow was blamed for the next year's blight.

    Rituals¶

    • The Uncut Corner — every field leaves its northeast corner uncut for Lobas — "the god's acre." At sundown, children run into the standing grain to drive out the harvest hare, and elders toss a sheaf back into the corner as thanks.
    • First Wagon to Citrea — the year's first grain wagon, garlanded with woven straw, rolls from Temas to Citrea's harbor. No toll may be levied on it; every village along the road adds a loaf. In Citrea the loaves are broken and shared with dockworkers before the grain is sold.
    • Straw Man of Lobas — a wicker figure of the god is built from last year's straw and burnt on the threshing floor; its ash is scattered on the field that will be sown first next spring.
    • Harvest Truce of Spears — Tissas — god of war, patron of neighboring Tissas — is formally asked to keep his spears sheathed until the grain is stored. Priests of Tissas attend and must answer "he will."

    Who Celebrates¶

    Heartland Temas and its grain-road neighbors — Citrea (which moves the grain), Mienna, Monik, and Maedon (who share Maokas's agriculture but honor Lobas on this day alone). The Corinite League cities (Corin, Taebea, Tessa, Klatia) keep a merchants' Harvest at the Beast's Bay grain exchange.

    Economics¶

    Temas Harvest is the pricing day for Dissenbarg grain — the year's most important commodity. The price set at Citrea on Harvest afternoon becomes the continent's benchmark until next Harvest.

    • Currency spent: Dissenbarg Krona — on Harvest, the Temas and Citrea Kronas trade at parity, erasing the usual 12 percent weight variance. All first-wagon grain is sold in Kronas, and the Citrea harbor dues are then calculated in Kronas for the rest of the year's shipments. Farmers settle in Krona but reckon in hands of grain — one notch on a Dissenbarg Krona is one hand of grain.
    • Anos factors from Tatak and Venner factors from Sua who buy Dissenbarg grain convert their Anosi Mark and Vennerian Ducat into Kronas at Harvest.

    Connections¶

    • Religion: Helism — patron Lobas (nature), guest rites for Maokas and Tissas
    • Region: Temas — inland Dissenbarg, grain road to Citrea
    • Date: Day 25, Month 9 (Ge'orian Calendar) — last sheaf cut, first wagon dispatched
    • Currency used: Dissenbarg Krona — grain benchmark price, Citrea harbor market
